Karthik / Marissa —

Quick ask: StrataLogic is in late-stage procurement (deal STR-2028-009). Their SREs just confirmed a target of ~8 concurrent inference workers at 2K tokens/sec peak for initial GA (model: Llama-3-70B, FP16 quant; fallback to 8-bit if needed). They want a firm statement that we can hold capacity for an initial 8 GPU-equivalent slots for 8–10 weeks while contracts close, with option to scale to ~24 in month 2.

Can you:
- Confirm current available dedicated capacity in us-west-2 that could satisfy an initial 8-GPU soft hold (ideally H100-equivalent), and whether we can place a provisional reservation starting next Monday (2028-01-16).
- Estimate delta in monthly committed cost for reserving 8 GPUs vs. burst-on-demand (ballpark ok).
- Flag any infra / lead times (driver/OS image, autoscale config, model warmup, KV cache priming) that would affect the ramp.

I attached the customer-reported perf numbers and our sizing worksheet (capacity-plan-v2.xlsx). If we can provision a soft hold, I need the internal hold-id and the exact next steps we ask procurement to follow (PO template, contact email to send PO to).

This is time-sensitive — the AE is expecting confirmation by EOD Monday.

Thanks,
Hannah

Hannah —

Thanks for the summary. Short answer: yes, we can place a provisional soft hold for the initial 8-GPU footprint in us-west-2 with current inventory, but a few caveats. Details below.

Current inventory and options:
- us-west-2 dedicated pool: ~72 H100-equivalent slots free in the next 6 weeks (after committed jobs are scheduled).
- We can carve a soft hold of 8 GPUs (H100-equivalent) starting 2028-01-16 for up to 10 weeks without impacting existing reserved customers.

Recommended configuration for StrataLogic initial phase:
- 8 H100-equivalent: 4 nodes x 2 GPUs (NVLink-backed) with autoscale ceiling at 24 GPUs.
- Model config: run with FP16 quant; plan an 8-bit rollout path if cost pressure suggests.

Cost delta (ballpark monthly):
- Committed reserve 8 GPUs (reserved discount): ~$48k/month (commit pricing, includes support).
- Burst-on-demand 8 GPUs (no commit): ~$112k/month at assumed 50% utilization (inefficient for steady workloads).
- Note: these are rough; finance will produce exact figures once PO term is set.

Operational lead times / notes:
- Image and model bake: 24–48 hours to stage model image + KV cache priming once we have model artifact.
- Autoscale policy: we'll configure an initial conservative policy to avoid cold-start tokens; subsequent tuning required as traffic pattern stabilizes.
- Can provide a warm-up run prior to customer GA (can be scheduled during low-peak).

Next steps I can take this week:
1) Create an internal provisional hold (soft) and produce hold id.
2) Draft the required infra ticket (INF-4532) and link it to the deal (HUBSPOT-546210).
3) Provide the precise PO template required for finance (cc: Marissa for procurement).

If you want, I can also propose a hybrid approach: reserve 4 GPUs as committed and allow burst to 8–12 for the first month to reduce committed cost while preserving headroom.

Marking this high priority — I’ll create a hold if you give the go-ahead.

–Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Head of Capacity Planning, Redwood Inference
